extension.summary: Real fanart backgrounds for the currently playing music artist
extension.description: Lightweight replacement for Artist Slideshow. Looks up TheAudioDB / fanart.tv / Deezer for the currently playing artist and exposes the result via Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), compatible with the existing Aeon Nox 5 MusicVisualisation.xml patch. Runs as a proper Kodi background service (started once at Kodi startup) instead of a re-invoked script, avoiding the stuck/zombie "already running" issue.
extension.news: 1.1.0: added Deezer as a third image source (no API key needed) - mainly helps Slovak/Czech and other regional artists that TheAudioDB/fanart.tv don't have at all. Added an on-screen "searching for fanart..." notification on first fetch for a new artist, so it's clear something is happening during the initial download delay. 1.0.0: initial release.
